blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Social simulation offers the social sciences an experimental instrument that the real world cannot supply, and generative agents have transformed it by acting as silicon samples that unite agent-based modeling with real behavioral data.
Existing platforms verify collective behavior, align simulated populations with real societies in cross-sections, and employ autonomous agents for the research process. However, two social science requirements remain without systematic support: intervention in the content of a simulation and the researcher’s control over the process that produces it.
We present SocioVerse2 , which extends SocioVerse 1.0 into a human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm built from two loops and one infrastructure.
The longitudinal simulation loop simulates the target population with evolving environments and forks counterfactual branches via interventions.
The controllable research loop takes the study itself as an editable state and updates state versions via controllable editing.
The social science agentic infrastructure carries both loops through composable skills with researcher checkpoints, a population service over five persona pools, and an environment service over 21 real-world signal sources with point-in-time guarantees.
We validate SocioVerse2 across three case families and seven case studies, from reproducing canonical agent-based models to modeling policy processes on real records and nowcasting macro-economic indices beyond the response model’s knowledge cutoff.
With the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm, these cases go beyond system demonstrations to become substantive studies that investigate frontier questions in their respective disciplines.
Code, data services, and a workbench are released as open-source resources.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Social simulations offer the social sciences an experimental instrument that the real world cannot supply: traditional field experiments are costly, hard to reproduce, and ethically bounded, while a simulated society places populations, environments, and interventions under direct control [ 1 , 2 ] . Generative agents have further transformed social simulations. By combining rule-based agent-based modeling (ABM) with real-world behavioral data, they act as “silicon samples” capable of humanoid reasoning and natural-language expression [ 3 , 4 ] .
Recently, a fast-growing family of studies has built social simulators and platforms to expand the toolkit of social science research, from hand-built sandboxes [ 5 , 6 ] to agent-operated workflows [ 7 , 8 ] , from reactive verification that reproduces known phenomena to proactive exploration that asks what would follow from conditions never observed, such as an untested policy [ 9 , 10 ] .
blocks.zh:
社会模拟为社会科学提供了现实世界无法提供的实验性仪器:传统的野外实验成本昂贵,难以复制,而且有道德界限,而模拟社会将人口,环境和干预置于直接控制之下[1,2]. 基因剂进一步改变了社会模拟. 通过将基于规则的物剂模型(ABM)与现实世界的行为数据相结合,它们起到“硅样本”的作用,能够进行人造推理和自然语言表达[3,4].
最近,一个发展迅速的研究家族建立了社会模拟器和平台,以扩大社会科学研究工具包,从手工建造的沙盒[5,6]到代理操作的工作流程[7,8],从复制已知现象的被动核查到主动的探索,询问从从未观察到的条件,如未经检验的政策[9,10],会有什么结果.

blocks.en:
However, these platforms produce collective behaviors and simulated populations that rely solely on computational, systematic design and the abilities of autonomous agents [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 8 ] .
Recent audits show that autonomous research agents can fabricate results and drift from their announced plans, producing unqualified papers below publication standards [ 16 , 17 , 18 ] .
Accordingly, the core requirements that facilitate social science lie in experimental intervention over research content and human scientists’ control over the research process.
Human involvement has been shown to be an effective means of mitigating base models’ limited transferability. Researcher feedback at each stage significantly improves agent-generated research [ 19 , 20 ] and human decision gates raise the share of feasible hypotheses in empirical social science [ 21 ] .
For such collaborative requirements between human researchers and autonomous agents, current social science simulation platforms offer little systematic support ( Section 2 ).
blocks.zh:
然而,这些平台产生集体行为和模拟人群,完全依赖于计算,系统设计和自主代理的能力[11,12,13,14,15,8].
最近的审计表明,自主研究代理人可以编造结果并偏离其公布的计划,产生低于出版标准的不合格论文[16,17,18].
因此,促进社会科学的核心要求在于实验性干预研究内容和人类科学家对研究过程的控制。
事实证明,人类的参与是减轻基本模型有限可转让性的有效手段。 研究人员在每一阶段的反馈都大大改进了代理生成的研究[19,20],人类的决策门提高了可行假设在实证社会科学中的份额[21].
对于人类研究人员和自主代理人之间的此类合作要求,目前的社会科学模拟平台几乎没有提供系统的支持(第2节)。

blocks.en: We formulate these considerations as a human–AI co-evolutionary paradigm along three dimensions. Longitudinal Intervention : social phenomena emerge and evolve over time [ 22 , 23 ] . During this dynamic process, designed intervention experiments are essential for isolating and studying different variables and supporting counterfactual hypotheses [ 24 , 25 ] . Social simulation platforms should therefore create diverse control groups that cannot be simply reproduced from existing reality [ 26 , 27 ] , as shown along the y-axis of Figure 1 . Controllable Loop : as shown along the x-axis of Figure 1 , early rigid sandboxes fix every simulation setting, including information flow, agentic framework, interactive topology, etc., and thus limit the evolving ability of silicon samples [ 3 , 5 ] . In contrast, current autonomous research platforms leave the simulation entirely in the coding agent’s hands and pursue an end-to-end simulator [ 7 , 28 ] . The importance of human-in-the-loop during the research process should be highlighted to create a controllable loop [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] , especially in complex, iterative science experiments [ 32 , 33 ] . Foundation Basis : beyond the base model’s ability, the quality of social simulations relies on the grounding data and agent infrastructure [ 34 ] . Behaviors generated during the simulation should align with real-world populations and environments [ 35 , 14 , 36 , 37 ] . The system therefore must retrieve grounded information, assemble it into context, map it to actions, and update it iteratively through an adaptive agentic harness that expands the frontier of social science research.
blocks.zh: 我们把这些考虑作为人类——AI共同进化的范式,分三个方面。 纵向干预:社会现象随着时间推移而出现和演变[22,23]. 在这一动态过程中,设计的干预实验对于隔离和研究不同的变量和支持反事实假设[24,25]至关重要. 因此,社会模拟平台应创建不同的控制组,不能简单地从现有现实中复制[26,27],如图1的y轴所示。 可控环:如图1的x轴上所示,早期刚性沙盒固定每个模拟设置,包括信息流,代理框架,交互式地形等,从而限制了硅样品的演化能力[3,5]. 相比之下,目前的自主研究平台将模拟完全交给编码代理商,并追求端到端模拟器[7,28]. 应当强调人类在研究过程中的重要性,以创造可控制的循环[29,30,31],特别是在复杂的迭代科学实验中[32,33]. 基础:除了基准模型的能力外,社会模拟的质量依赖于地面数据和代理基础设施[34]。 在模拟过程中产生的行为应当与现实世界的人口和环境相一致[35、14、36、37]。 因此,该系统必须检索基于基础的信息,将其组合到上下文中,将其映射到行动上,并通过一种适应性工具加以更新,从而扩大社会科学研究的前沿。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present SocioVerse2 that aims to bridge the gap between current platforms and social science research requirements.
In SocioVerse 1.0, we organized simulation around four alignment-centered engines: the social environment, the user engine, the scenario engine, and the behavior engine [ 14 ] . SocioVerse2 carries this design forward and extends it into a human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm using Two loops and One infrastructure : the longitudinal simulation loop , the controllable research loop , and the social science agentic infrastructure ( Section 3 ).
The SocioVerse2 framework models social simulation as collective behaviors of silicon samples that depend on the joint effects of real-world heterogeneous populations and grounded social-environment signals, where a unified formulation is employed to demonstrate both the simulation loop and research loop (§ 3.1 ). We explain the implementation of the longitudinal feature in the simulation loop (§ 3.2 ), then introduce intervention operations that create branches to compare counterfactuals and variables (§ 3.3 ). We introduce controllable editing in the research loop, enabling diverse versions across the research process (§ 3.4 ). Human social scientists can engage through both loops by designing counterfactual experiments, providing feedback, and making adjustments, thereby enabling co-evolution between humans and social science agents.
The loops are supported by a social science agentic infrastructure, including a complete lifecycle workflow and two standard model context protocols (MCP) for population alignment and environment grounding ( Section 4 ).
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了旨在弥合现有平台与社会科学研究要求之间的差距的SocialVerse2。
在SocialVerse 1.0中,我们围绕四个以对齐为中心的引擎组织模拟:社会环境,用户引擎,情景引擎,行为引擎[14]. SocialVerse2将这一设计推向前进,并运用两个循环和一个基础设施(纵向模拟循环、可控研究循环和社会科学代理基础设施(第3节))扩展为人类-AI共同进化范式。
SocialVerse2框架将社会模拟作为硅样品的集体行为模式,这些模拟取决于现实世界不同人群和基于社会-环境信号的共同影响,其中采用了统一的配方,以证明模拟循环和研究循环(第3.1节)。 我们解释模拟循环(§3.2)中纵向特征的落实,然后引入干预操作,创建分支来比较反事实和变量(§3.3). 我们在研究循环中引入可控制的编辑,使整个研究过程能够有多种版本(第3.4节)。 人类社会科学家可以通过设计反事实实验,提供反馈,并做出调整,从而实现人类与社会科学代理人之间的共同进化,通过这两个循环进行接触.
环路由一个社会科学代理基础设施支持,包括一个完整的生命周期工作流程和两个用于人口调整和环境定位的标准模式环境协议(第4节)。

blocks.en:
We validate SocioVerse2 across three case families and seven case studies with systematic evaluation methods (§ 5.1 ). Simulation mechanisms focus on interpretation of social mechanisms and phenomena in different social science fields (§ 5.2 ). Policy simulation studies the potential results during the policymaking process (§ 5.3 ). Macro-index forecasting uses real-world deterministic indices and signals as ground truth to evaluate the framework’s quantitative performance (§ 5.4 ).
Each family carries its own real-world grounding, and together they cover simulation goals from verifying known dynamics to estimating future potentials, from helping design policies to predicting indices ahead of time.
The two loops turn these cases from single runs into practical research. Every mechanism probe in the designs, from the intervention of the opinion dynamics to the ablations of the policy forecasting, is either a branch raised inside the simulation loop or a version raised by the researcher in the research loop, so that each reported gain is attributable to a controlled change of the population, the environment, or the behavior function. Researchers enter both loops in every case, declaring interventions, replacing components after inspecting the panel records, and deciding which version is reported, and it is this collaboration rather than one autonomous pass that carries a case to a result validated against ground truth.
blocks.zh:
我们通过系统评估方法(第5.1节),对3个案例家庭和7个案例进行验证。 模拟机制侧重于对不同社会科学领域社会机制和现象的解释(第5.2节)。 政策模拟研究决策过程中的潜在结果(第5.3节)。 宏观指数预测使用现实世界的决定性指数和信号作为地面真理来评价框架的量化性能(§5.4)。
每个家庭都有自己的现实世界定位,它们共同涵盖模拟目标,从核实已知动态到估计未来潜力,从帮助设计政策到提前预测指数。
这两条环路将这些案件从单流变为实用研究. 设计中的每一个机制探险,从意见动态的干预到政策预测的崩盘,要么是模拟循环内提升的分支,要么是研究者在研究循环内提升的版本,这样每个报告的收益都归因于人口,环境,或行为功能的控制变化. 研究人员在每一个案件中都输入两个循环,宣布干预,在检查小组记录后更换组件,并决定报告哪个版本,只有这种协作而不是一个自主的传球,才能得出与地面真相相反的结果。

blocks.en: In general, our contributions are: • A Dynamic Longitudinal Simulation Framework. We formalize the shift from cross-sectional prediction to longitudinal trajectory simulation. • A Human-AI Co-evolutionary Research Paradigm. We combine autonomous agents with human social scientists in two collaborative and co-evolutionary loops via interventions and editable components. • A Social Science Agentic Infrastructure. We release the SocioVerse2 runtime as a modular open-source package, together with standardized MCP services for population alignment and environment grounding, an agentic skill pipeline, and an online research workbench that make the entire study lifecycle auditable and reproducible.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,我们的贡献是:动态纵向模拟框架。 我们正式确定从截面预测向纵向轨迹模拟的转变。 • 人类-AI共同革命研究范式。 我们通过干预和可编辑的组成部分,将自主代理人与人类社会科学家结合起来,形成两个协作和共进循环。 • 社会科学代理基础设施。 我们发布了SocialVerse2运行时间作为模块化的开源软件包,同时发布了用于人口调整和环境定位的标准化MCP服务,一个代理技能管道,以及一个在线研究工作台,使整个研究生命周期可以审计和复制。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Positioning
blocks.zh: 2 背景和定位

blocks.zh: 表1:代表性LLM社会模拟平台,按发布日期排序. QQ支持,\\circ=部分,——=不支持.

blocks.en:
Since large language models became the decision engine of social simulation agents, platforms have proliferated, and Figure 1 maps them on the two axes along which they differ. Human-AI Cooperation describes how a study is operated, from entirely human experts’ handcrafted design to full agent automation. At one end, the hand-crafted sandbox fixes the information flow and interaction topology. The configurable framework relaxes this by exposing the population, the environment, and the scenario as parameters.
At the other end, autonomous agents take a question, carry out experiments independently, and finally return a report. Human researchers provide little feedback during the whole loop. We aim for harmonious collaboration in the middle, where agents operate the machinery interactively, guided by researchers’ feedback.
blocks.zh:
由于大型语言模型成为社会模拟代理商的决策引擎,平台激增,图1将它们映射在它们所不同的两个轴上. Human-AI合作介绍一项研究是如何运作的,从完全由人类专家手工设计到完全的代理自动化。 在一端,手工制作的沙盒固定了信息流和相互作用的地形. 可配置的框架通过将人口、环境和情景暴露为参数来缓解这种情况。
另一方面,自主的代理人接受一个问题,独立地进行实验,最后返回一个报告. 人类研究人员在整个循环期间提供的反馈很少. 我们的目标是在中间进行和谐的合作,在中间,代理人在研究人员的反馈指导下,以互动的方式运作这一机制。

blocks.en: Simulation Goals describe what a study is for, from passive execution to active design. Reactive verification asks whether a simulation reproduces known behavior patterns or phenomena, and the results are expected. Proactive exploration asks what would happen from current conditions, which requires introducing unknown interventions in the simulation and modifying the simulation structure, rather than only observing it.
blocks.zh: 模拟目标描述研究的目的,从被动执行到主动设计. 反应核查询问模拟是否复制了已知的行为模式或现象,结果是预期的. 主动探索询问当前条件会发生什么,这需要在模拟中引入未知的干预,并修改模拟结构,而不仅仅是观察.

blocks.en: Within this landscape, the literature has advanced in three successive waves. • Verifying behaviors in hand-built worlds. Generative Agents [ 3 ] placed 25 LLM-driven characters in a hand-built village and demonstrated for the first time that LLM agents could spontaneously spread information, form relationships, and coordinate collective activities. Subsequent systems carried this evidence to social-network and macroeconomic settings [ 5 , 38 ] , and Concordia [ 6 ] and OASIS [ 15 ] recast the hand-built sandbox as a configurable framework, the latter scaling to one million agents. In this wave, the run itself remains closed: its trajectory is not an object of study, and nothing can be intervened on once it has started. • Alignment with real societies. A second wave anchored simulation in real data. Within predefined scenarios, HiSim [ 11 ] aligned simulated discourse with real social-media contexts and Generative Agent–1000 [ 12 ] constructed agents from interviews with 1,000 real individuals. Among configurable platforms, AgentSociety [ 13 ] embedded 10k agents in realistic urban infrastructure and SocioVerse 1.0 [ 14 ] aligned simulated populations to census marginals over a large real-user pool. This wave improves the simulation fidelity, but the comparison it draws is cross-sectional. Real data also enters as a dataset assembled once per study, so changing the population or the environment means collecting it again. • Research automation by agentic workflows. The most recent wave hands off the research process itself to agents. YuLan-OneSim [ 7 ] pairs code-free, agent-operated scenario construction that takes a topic and finishes the loop on its own, from environment construction through report review. AgentSociety 2 [ 8 ] couples AI social scientists and silicon participants in one runtime. The autonomous agents in this wave turn to actively execute to solve researchers’ questions, while the research purpose is fixed once initialized. The lack of human steering restricts agents’ global view of the research scope. The researcher is left with gated approval over what the agent exposes, not full control of the edit.
blocks.zh: 在这个风景范围内,文学连续三波不断地进步. · 核查人工世界中的行为。 Generative Agents [3] 将25个LLM驱动的字符放置在一个手工建造的村庄,并首次证明LLM代理能够自发地传播信息,形成关系,协调集体活动. 随后的系统将这一证据带入社会网络和宏观经济环境[5,38],康科迪亚[6]和美洲组织信息系统[15]将手工建造的沙盒重塑为可配置的框架,后者规模达到100万个代理商。 在这波中,跑步本身仍然闭塞:它的轨迹不是研究对象,一旦开始就没有什么可以干预的. • 与真正的社会保持一致。 真实数据中的第二波定位模拟。 在预先设定的情景中,HiSim [11] 将模拟话语与真实的社会-媒体背景和Generative Agent – 1000 [12] 通过对1000名真实个人的采访而构建的代理. 在可配置平台中,AgentSocious [13] 将10k的代理嵌入现实城市基础设施中,SocialVerse 1.0 [14] 将模拟人口与大实体用户池上的边缘人口进行普查。 这波提高了模拟忠心度,但是它所作的比较是交叉的. 真实数据也作为每次研究一次汇总的数据集输入,因此改变人口或环境意味着再次收集. • 按代理工作流程进行自动化研究。 最近一波将研究过程本身交给代理人。 YuLan-OneSim [7] 配对无码,代理操作的情景构建,取一个话题并自行完成循环,从环境建设到报告审查. AgentSocity 2[8]夫妇AI 社会科学家和硅参与者在一次运行中. 这种浪潮中的自主代理人转而积极执行以解决研究人员的问题,而研究目的一旦初始化就固定下来了. 缺乏人的指导限制了代理人对研究范围的全球看法。 研究者对特工曝光的内容有门式批准,对编辑不完全控制.

Subsequent systems carried this evidence to social-network and macroeconomic settings [ 5 , 38 ] , and Concordia [ 6 ] and OASIS [ 15 ] recast the hand-built sandbox as a configurable framework, the latter scaling to one million agents. In this wave, the run itself remains closed: its trajectory is not an object of study, and nothing can be intervened on once it has started.
blocks.zh: 验证人工构建世界中的行为. Generative Agents [3] 将25个LLM驱动的字符放置在一个手工建造的村庄,并首次证明LLM代理能够自发地传播信息,形成关系,协调集体活动. 随后的系统将这一证据带入社会网络和宏观经济环境[5,38],康科迪亚[6]和美洲组织信息系统[15]将手工建造的沙盒重塑为可配置的框架,后者规模达到100万个代理商。 在这波中,跑步本身仍然闭塞:它的轨迹不是研究对象,一旦开始就没有什么可以干预的.

blocks.en: Alignment with real societies. A second wave anchored simulation in real data. Within predefined scenarios, HiSim [ 11 ] aligned simulated discourse with real social-media contexts and Generative Agent–1000 [ 12 ] constructed agents from interviews with 1,000 real individuals. Among configurable platforms, AgentSociety [ 13 ] embedded 10k agents in realistic urban infrastructure and SocioVerse 1.0 [ 14 ] aligned simulated populations to census marginals over a large real-user pool. This wave improves the simulation fidelity, but the comparison it draws is cross-sectional. Real data also enters as a dataset assembled once per study, so changing the population or the environment means collecting it again.
blocks.zh: 与真正的社会保持一致。 真实数据中的第二波定位模拟。 在预先设定的情景中,HiSim [11] 将模拟话语与真实的社会-媒体背景和Generative Agent – 1000 [12] 通过对1000名真实个人的采访而构建的代理. 在可配置平台中,AgentSocious [13] 将10k的代理嵌入现实城市基础设施中,SocialVerse 1.0 [14] 将模拟人口与大实体用户池上的边缘人口进行普查。 这波提高了模拟忠心度,但是它所作的比较是交叉的. 真实数据也作为每次研究一次汇总的数据集输入,因此改变人口或环境意味着再次收集.

blocks.en: Research automation by agentic workflows. The most recent wave hands off the research process itself to agents. YuLan-OneSim [ 7 ] pairs code-free, agent-operated scenario construction that takes a topic and finishes the loop on its own, from environment construction through report review. AgentSociety 2 [ 8 ] couples AI social scientists and silicon participants in one runtime. The autonomous agents in this wave turn to actively execute to solve researchers’ questions, while the research purpose is fixed once initialized. The lack of human steering restricts agents’ global view of the research scope. The researcher is left with gated approval over what the agent exposes, not full control of the edit.
blocks.zh: 按代理工作流程进行研究自动化. 最近一波将研究过程本身交给代理人。 YuLan-OneSim [7] 配对无码,代理操作的情景构建,取一个话题并自行完成循环,从环境建设到报告审查. AgentSocity 2[8]夫妇AI 社会科学家和硅参与者在一次运行中. 这种浪潮中的自主代理人转而积极执行以解决研究人员的问题,而研究目的一旦初始化就固定下来了. 缺乏人的指导限制了代理人对研究范围的全球看法。 研究者对特工曝光的内容有门式批准,对编辑不完全控制.

blocks.en: SocioVerse2 supplies the missing capability, offering dynamic longitudinal simulation operated through a human-AI coevolutionary paradigm. SocioVerse2 complements end-to-end research automation via intervention and counterfactual experiments within the simulation and human-controllable loop outside the research process. On the other hand, SocioVerse2 strengthens the configured framework via lifecycle agentic infrastructure and data MCPs. Standing at the intersection of professional human social scientists’ expertise and efficient agents’ automation, we believe SocioVerse2 builds a promising and powerful paradigm for the next era of social simulation.
blocks.zh: SocialVerse2提供缺失的能力,提供动态纵向模拟,通过人与AI的共演模式操作. SocialVerse2通过模拟内部的干预和反事实实验以及研究过程外的人类可控循环来补充端到端的研究自动化. 另一方面,SocialVerse2通过生命周期代理基础设施和数据MCP加强了配置的框架. 站在人类专业社会科学家的专业知识和高效代理自动化的交汇点上,我们认为SocialVerse2为下一个社会模拟时代树立了一个充满希望和强大的典范。

blocks.en: 3 SocioVerse2 Human-AI Co-evolutionary Paradigm
blocks.zh: 3 社会变数2 人类-AI共同革命范式

blocks.en: Section 3 and Section 4 present the SocioVerse2 framework as two loops and one agentic infrastructure, revealing three levels of granularity in social science research: from one step to one branch, and finally the whole tree of runs that a study focuses on, as shown in Figure 2 . We first formalize the necessary preliminaries in § 3.1 , then we detail every component. Typically, given a research question, the researcher and the social science agent collaborate through a longitudinal simulation loop and a controllable research loop , supported by social science agentic infrastructure . The longitudinal simulation loop directly runs the target simulation experiment step by step through iterations between simulated behaviors and the environment (§ 3.2 ), and enables interventions and comparison of counterfactual outcomes with the control group through branches (§ 3.3 ). The controllable research loop manages different versions throughout the research process by applying edits to any component of the study state (§ 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 第3节和第4节将SocialVerse2框架称为两个环和一个代理基础设施,揭示了社会科学研究中三个层次的颗粒性:从一个步骤到一个分支,最后是研究所关注的整个运行树,如图2所示。 我们首先在第3.1节中正式确定必要的初步性,然后详细列出每个组成部分。 通常,鉴于一个研究问题,研究人员和社会科学代理人通过纵向模拟循环和可控研究循环进行协作,并得到社会科学代理人基础设施的支持。 纵向模拟循环通过模拟行为与环境之间的迭代,直接逐级运行目标模拟实验(§3.2),并通过分支(§3.3)与控制组进行干涉和对比反事实结果. 可控研究循环管理整个研究过程中的不同版本,将编辑应用到研究状态的任何部分(§3.4).

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview and Formalization
blocks.zh: 3.1 概述和正式化

blocks.en:
Lewin’s field theory [ 39 ] expresses a foundational insight of social psychology: behavior arises jointly from the person and the environment.
We adopt the theory here for a practical formulation: it separates the population and environment and therefore provides a compact expression for both the passage of time and an introduced intervention. SocioVerse 1.0 [ 14 ] realized the relation as alignment-centered components. SocioVerse2 develops this line from single decisions into a social process: behavior computed at one step reshapes the environment that conditions the next, and the researcher’s interventions enter the same environment and propagate through the same loop. Outside the loop, the social process itself is editable under the guidance of human researchers.
blocks.zh:
莱温的场论[39]表达了社会心理学的基础洞察力:行为是由人与环境共同产生的.
我们在此采用这一理论,以便提出一个实际的提法:它把人口和环境分开,因此,它为时间的流逝和引入的干预提供了紧凑的表达方式。 SocialVerse 1.0 [14] 实现了以对齐为中心的组件的关系. SocialVerse2将这条线从单一决定发展成一个社会过程:一步一步计算的行为重塑了附加条件的环境,研究者的干预进入同一个环境,并通过同样的循环传播. 在循环之外,社会过程本身可以在人类研究者的指导下编辑.

blocks.en:
SocioVerse2 condenses social simulation into B = f ⁡ ( P , E ) , B=f(P,\,E), (1) where P P is the population, E E the environment, f f the behavior engine, and B B the resulting behavior.
The abstraction is powerful precisely because its three terms are independently replaceable: P P may be drawn from a real-world user pool or synthesized from census marginals. E E may be grounded in live event streams or designed for a stylized experiment. f f may be a classical ABM rule, an LLM prompt chain, a learned reinforcement-learning policy, or a hybrid of these.
Any social simulation scenario, from Schelling segregation to macro-economic nowcasting, can be expressed as an instantiation of Equation 1 . Consequently, an intervention can be viewed as an operation on E E with P P and f f held fixed, and a controlled adjustment can be viewed as modifying any components among B , f , P B,f,P and E E .

任何社会模拟情景,从舍灵隔离到宏观经济即时播报,都可以表示为即时化的方程式1 . 因此,干预可被视为在E E上进行具有P P 和 f f f 固定的操作,控制下的调整可被视为修改B、f、P B、f、P和E E 中的任何组件。

blocks.en: In SocioVerse2 , the population P P is the set of agents (or silicon samples) whose behaviors the simulation tracks. Generally, a population is fixed with the initialization of the study to provide persistent subjects for the social simulation. The environment E E is the sum of information external to the agents that shapes their behavior. Generally, the environment is orchestrated along two orthogonal axes: modality and scope. Modality separates the physical world from the information world (i.e., geography and urban facilities v.s. news and policies), while scope separates macro context from micro context (i.e., broadcast v.s. direct message). Both P P and E E are assembled by a skill-based agentic research pipeline (§ 4.1 ), where real-world data is acquired via standard MCPs across studies (§ 4.2 and § 4.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Implementations of a Step
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 一项步骤的执行情况

blocks.en: The three components below detail the implementations and configurations in the longitudinal simulation loop.
blocks.zh: 以下三个部分详细介绍了纵向模拟循环中的执行和配置.

blocks.en:
Beyond identity, each persona specifies three study-relevant properties: (1) a cohort label that groups demographically similar agents for efficient batched decision-making (e.g., an archetype representing an ethnic group), (2) an optional sampling weight when a small agent set represents a larger population, and (3) an initial state that seeds its situation at step 0 (a home tract, an initial opinion, a starting budget).
A study also declares the social connection among its agents, through spatial adjacency, an explicit social network, or no interaction at all, and the propagation of influence along those connections, from fully independent decisions to contagion-style local spread to broadcast-then-discussion patterns typical of social media.
Messages between connected agents travel through a mediated bus and are delivered by neighbor lookup, so an agent’s local-information field carries the posts of its network neighbors from earlier rounds of the current step and from the previous step.

除了身份以外,每个人a 都指定了三种与研究有关的属性: (1) 将人口结构上相似的物剂归类为高效分批决策的物剂(例如代表族裔群体的古老类型),(2) 当一个小物剂集代表一个更大的人口时可选择的采样权重,以及(3) 初始状态在0级(家庭道、初步意见、起始预算)播种。
一项研究还宣布,通过空间联系、明确的社会网络或根本没有互动,以及传播从完全独立的决定到传染式的本地传播到社交媒体典型的广播-讨论模式,其代理人之间的社会联系。
连接的代理商之间的消息通过一个介导的大巴运行,由邻居查询发送,所以代理商的本地信息域会携带其网络邻居的帖子,这些帖子来自当前步骤的前几轮和前一步.

blocks.en: Each agent owns a bounded window of its own recent actions, eight steps by default and configurable per study. Because the window is filled from the actions that the panel records, it can be rebuilt exactly from the panel table, allowing a branched run to inherit its agents’ histories.

blocks.en:
The decision model is the only component that computes f f , and because every implementation returns the typed action of phase 3, the environment and the record store are independent of the mechanism that produced a decision.
Four behavior functions are implemented. Rule- f f evaluates a classical update rule and serves as the parity baseline. LLM- f f composes the persona, the four observation fields, and the memory window into a prompt, parses the structured reply into an action. RL- f f maps observations to actions through a trained policy, one per class of strategic actor, and enters the workspace through an adapter. Hybrid- f f assigns different implementations to different agent groups within one run, typically LLM- f f for a small core and rule- f f for the remainder.
The typed-action contract is also what makes the rule-versus-LLM comparison possible, since both implementations act in the same discrete action space.

blocks.en:
An intervention is an entry in the environment bundle, implemented in two types: a scheduled event or a broadcast ( Figure 4(a) ).
A scheduled event names a physical layer, a step, a numeric operation, a value, and a selector for the affected units, together with a note. A broadcast carries an information content, a channel, a step, a time-to-live, and an audience that is either everyone or a selector.
An intervention is verified to ensure every event targets a declared layer, and every broadcast requires a declared information layer.
Both kinds activate in the exogenous phase of their step, before any agent observes, and the engine writes each activation to the events table and attaches the notes to that step’s metrics row, so the change in a metric series is read against before the intervention.

干预是环境捆绑的条目,分为两类:预定活动或广播(图4(a))。
计划的事件命名一个物理层,一个步骤,一个数字操作,一个值,以及一个受影响单位的选择器,同时有一个注释. 广播内容包括信息内容,频道,台阶,直播时间,观众要么是每个人,要么是选择者.
一次干预被核实,以确保每个事件都针对一个宣布的层层,每次广播都需要一个宣布的信息层.
两样都在其步骤的外在阶段激活,在任何物剂观察之前,引擎将每个激活都写到事件表,并将注释附在该步骤的度量行上,因此在干预前对照一个度量序列的变化来读取.

blocks.en:
A branch is a new run that inherits a parent run’s first t ∗ − 1 t^{*}{-}1 steps and diverges afterward.
The engine produces it by replay: it materializes P P and E 0 E_{0} from the same bundles and seed, then for steps 1 1 to t ∗ − 1 t^{*}{-}1 activates the parent’s schedule, reads the parent’s stored actions for that step from its panel table, applies them to the environment with the source label replay, pushes them into the agents’ memory windows, and records the resulting rows. From step t ∗ t^{*} , it calls the decision model as usual.
Because the environment transition of a study is a function of the recorded actions, the replayed rows reproduce the parent’s rows exactly. The environment reaches the same E t ∗ − 1 E_{t^{*}{-1}} , and each agent resumes with the same memory window it had in the parent.
Two branches forked from the same parent therefore share an identical realized history, and everything that differs between them after step t ∗ t^{*} is attributable to the schedules declared for the steps after the fork. Figure 4 shows the mechanism in an opinion-diffusion study: a parent run of eight steps is forked at step 4 into a control branch with no further intervention and a treatment branch whose bundle adds a media campaign at step 5. The two branches reproduce the parent’s rows for steps 0 to 4 exactly, invoke the decision model only for steps 5 to 8, and diverge from step 5.
The same mechanism extends a finished run to a longer horizon at no cost for the inherited steps and resumes an interrupted run from its last completed step.

blocks.en: 3.4 The Controllable Research Loop
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 可控研究循环

blocks.en:
This subsection answers how to control the study state version, from a k a_{k} to a k + 1 a_{k+1} . We step outside the simulation loop, extending to the research loop in which the research itself is updated.
The Equation 3 carries two objects, an edit action a k a_{k} on the study state and the map h h that applies it.
The research agent may raise an edit a k a_{k} from the reasoning over last trajectory. The researcher may raise it directly as well on any artifact and at any stage of the study via either verbalized instructions, additional materials, or direct code modifications.
What the researcher holds is therefore not a veto over agent proposals but authorship of the edit itself, and the loop is controllable in that stronger sense: the research process is editable at every point, not merely approvable at the points an agent chooses to expose.

Every branch, extension, or re-run is a version of the same study ( Figure 5 ).
A version manifest in the study workspace lists each version with its identifier, parent version, note, creation time, and, for branches, the source version and fork step. Creating a version snapshots the complete workspace of the current version, including the code, bundles, trajectory, and reports, so that earlier results remain inspectable and re-runnable.
The iterate skill (§ 4.1 ) creates versions on request and re-enters the workflow at the earliest stage a change affects. Notably, the branch differs from the version in the edit domain. A branch changes E E alone, holding P P , f f , and the seed fixed, and inheriting the parent’s realized history, which belongs precisely to the inner longitudinal simulation loop. In contrast, a version may change any artifact arbitrarily, so it does not inherit a history. Instead, it supports comparing one study design with another.

blocks.en:
Because P P , E E , and f f are separate replaceable artifacts and every run is a version with a recorded lineage, a study can grow by adding versions that vary one axis while holding the others fixed: • Population replacement. The same environment and behavior function can be applied to a different demographic composition (Census-synthesized U.S. adults versus personas from an open pool), testing whether findings generalize across populations. • Environment variation. The same population and behavior function can be exposed to fundamentally different environments (changing cities or interaction topologies for the same target groups), enabling controlled comparisons of environmental effects that can not be realized by event or broadcasting interventions. • Behavior-function ablation. Applying rule- f f , LLM- f f , and hybrid- f f on the same ( P , E ) (P,E) pair can isolating the decision model. • Data-source substitution. A different vintage of economic indicators or a different user pool through the resource manifest alone ( Section 4 ), with no change to model code. These designs can be combined together and applied in one version to provide a comprehensive result.
All versions store the records under the same contract, so a per-step metric or a per-agent trajectory is compared across versions with one query.

blocks.en:
Through the longitudinal simulation loop and controllable research loop, SocioVerse2 provides a paradigm in which human social scientists and autonomous agents collaborate and evolve with the research progression. This human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm sits in the middle of the landscape of Section 2 and draws on both of its ends at once. Autonomous agents get professional and experienced insights from human experts, filling the gap in transformational ability. Human researchers benefit from the efficient agentic infrastructure and generative agent-based simulation platforms, realizing innovation in research tools.
We expect the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm rather than either extreme to carry the next generation of social science simulation.

blocks.en: 4 Social Science Agentic Infrastructure
blocks.zh: 4 社会科学代理基础设施

blocks.en:
Section 3 defines what a study is . This section describes what it takes to run one, and it is the substance of our third contribution: the social science agentic infrastructure that carries both loops of Section 3 . It materializes a study state σ \sigma from real data, executes the longitudinal simulation loop on it, and gives the controllable research loop the named points at which an edit a k a_{k} is raised, applied by h h , and recorded.
It is organized in three layers.
The workflow layer decomposes the research lifecycle into composable skills, each of which reads the artifacts of earlier stages, writes one validated artifact of its own, and pauses for a researcher decision, so that the controllable research loop of § 3.4 is realized at named points rather than in principle (§ 4.1 ).
The service layer supplies a population service that anchors P P to real people and a signal service that grounds E E in real-world data, both exposed as typed model context protocol (MCP) tools rather than as datasets copied into a study (§ 4.2 and § 4.3 ).
The governance layer records what each stage did, which data it used, and what the researcher approved, so that a finished study can be audited and re-run (§ 4.4 ).
The runtime, the two services, and the case configurations are released as open-source packages, and an online workbench drives the same skills from a browser for researchers who do not work at a terminal.

blocks.en:
Keeping the services outside the framework is what makes both loops practical. Whenever the study changes, the agentic research pipeline can query MCPs instantly to build new environment orchestration or population distribution accordingly.
The population and environment sources therefore remain independently replaceable, the same typed interface serves both the internal skill pipeline and external agent ecosystems, and a third party can implement a compatible MCP server without modifying the framework.
The infrastructure is also where the co-evolutionary paradigm meet. Agents operate the skills and query the services, and the researcher’s edits enter through the same typed artifacts and checkpoints, so that a change raised by either side is applied, validated, and recorded in one place (§ 4.4 ).
blocks.zh:
将服务保留在框架之外是使两者循环都切合实际的原因。 当研究发生变化时,代理研究管道可以立即查询MCP,以构建新的环境管弦或相应的人口分布.
因此,人口和环境来源仍然可以独立替代,同一类型接口既服务于内部技能管道,也服务于外部物剂生态系统,第三方可以在不修改框架的情况下实施兼容的MCP服务器.
基础设施也是共同革命范式交汇的地方. 代理操作技能和查询服务,研究人员的编辑通过同一类型文物和检查站进入,以便适用、验证和记录任何一方提出的更改(第4.4节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Agentic Research Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.1 代理研究管道

blocks.en: Section 3 defines the simulation engine. This subsection describes the workflow layer that operates it, and it is where the controllable research loop of § 3.4 becomes concrete: each skill is a stage at which an edit a k a_{k} can be raised, and each checkpoint is a point at which the edit is applied with the researcher’s knowledge. SocioVerse2 takes a complementary approach compared to previous studies: the research lifecycle is decomposed into reusable skills, each of which reads the artifacts of earlier stages, writes one validated artifact of its own, and pauses for review, so that every intermediate result is inspectable and every decision point is recorded.

Each skill pauses after writing its artifact and summarizes what it produced, and the researcher decides whether to advance by default. A researcher who prefers to run the whole pipeline can enable auto mode as well.
Four decisions are always put to the researcher: (1) confirmation of the intent brief before a study is created, (2) the choice between a new version, an in-place edit, and a branch before an existing study is changed, (3) the expected cost before a run that calls a language model, and (4) the use of any data service whose terms require per-study confirmation.
Every answer is logged with the study, so the audit trail records both what the pipeline did and what the researcher approved.

每一个答案都记录在研究中,因此审计线索既记录了管道所做的,也记录了研究者批准的.

blocks.en: When a user describes a research need, init consults the study catalog and routes the query along one of three paths: • Path A (reuse/adjust). The query closely matches an existing study. The skill forks the matched study into a new study with its own version history, preserving the original as a read-only reference, and the user adjusts artifacts (population scale, intervention schedule) without writing code. • Path B (build from scratch). No existing study matches. build-model writes a model module that implements the engine’s four component interfaces. The engine assembles it from the component registry. • Path C (adapt legacy). The user has an existing simulator to integrate. An engine-seam adapter wraps the legacy code with zero modification, projecting its internal state onto the SocioVerse2 artifacts. Together the three paths form the framework’s extensibility contract, covering parameter variation, new research topics, and incremental migration of existing simulation ecosystems.

blocks.en: 4.2 The Multi-Source Persona Pool and the Population MCP
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 多来源个人池和人口MCP

blocks.en:
On the population side, the Population MCP is a multi-source aggregation service: it unifies five sub-pools, two internal real-user pools and three open persona pools, under one demographic label vocabulary. All the pools can be used aggregately to cover the research requirement.
The registered sources together span roughly one billion addressable persona records, of which 10,448,375 are locally indexed and queryable ( Table 3 ).

在人口方面,人口MCP是一个多源汇总服务:它统一了5个子集合,2个内部真用户集合和3个开放人物集合,在一个人口标签词汇下. 所有人才库可全部用于满足研究需求。
登记来源总共大约10亿个可地址的人的记录,其中10 448 375个是当地索引和可查询的(表3)。

blocks.en:
Table 3 summarizes the five sub-pools.
The internal pools inherit the real-user asset introduced in SocioVerse 1.0 [ 14 ] : 973,928 profiles from X/Twitter and 9,158,404 from Xiaohongshu/RedNote, for a combined 10,132,332 records. These profiles are tagged with demographic attributes through an LLM annotation pipeline with human review.
The preprocessed records are locally indexed for retrieval and sampling and serve as anchor pools contributing real users with real behavioral text. The cross-pool field union reaches 40 queryable fields, of which roughly 20 belong to a canonical demographic vocabulary (age, gender, education, income, marital status, employment, religion, ideology, race/ethnicity, region, urbanicity, occupation, seniority, party, children, political engagement, and others).

内部池继承了SocialVerse 1.0[14]中引入的真用户资产:X/Twitter的973,928个剖面图和小洪修/RedNote的9,158,404个剖面图,共计10,132,332个记录. 这些概况通过经过人文审查的LLM注释管道以人口属性标记。
预处理的记录是本地索引的,用于检索和取样,并作为主锚集合,提供真实的用户真实的行为文字. 跨池野战联盟达到40个可查询的领域,其中大约20个属于犬类人口词汇(年龄、性别、教育、收入、婚姻状况、就业、宗教、意识形态、种族/族裔、地区、城市、职业、资历、政党、儿童、政治参与等)。

blocks.en: Figure 7: One call to the Population MCP. A request specifies target marginals, required attributes, size, and seed. The service routes it across the five registered pools, samples and joins records, aligns them to the marginals by IPF, synthesizes what no pool covers under a synthetic label, and assembles the study population P P with persistent identifiers and attribute provenance.
blocks.zh: 图7:人口中心的一个电话。 请求指定了目标边际,所需的属性,大小,以及种子. 其服务路线跨越注册的5个池,取样和加入记录,由森林小组将其与边缘结合,合成一个合成标签下没有池盖的东西,并将研究人口PP组装为持久的识别特征和属性来源。

blocks.en:
Three open pools extend coverage along different axes, and each enters the service with an explicitly documented capability boundary.
Nemotron-Personas USA [ 40 ] contributes synthetic personas aligned to U.S. Census marginal distributions, each with a free-text persona description, and serves as a fully open counterpart to the internal pools for reproducible research.
MatrAIx Persona 1M [ 41 ] contributes the widest demographic schema, spanning 1,290 categorical dimensions upstream, from which we adopt the eighteen most analytically useful. Its authors state that the corpus is calibrated only on one-dimensional marginals and does not represent any real population, and a substantial share of its persona texts is generated from attributes, so records of this kind are labeled and never treated as real behavioral data.
PersonaHub [ 42 ] is the largest connected corpus, on the order of one billion synthetic personas, but is text-only: it carries no structured demographic fields, so it participates in retrieval and as textual material while being excluded, by design, from any distributional sampling.
New pools join through a declarative registration that records the source, its persona and demographic fields, and its attribution and usage terms. Adding an open dataset requires only this registration and a one-time normalization of its records into the shared vocabulary.
blocks.zh:
三个开放式池沿不同轴线延伸覆盖,每个池进入服务时都有明确记录的能力界限.
Nemotron-Personas USA [40] 提供与美国人口普查边际分布相一致的合成人,每个都有自由文字人物描述,并作为内部集合的完全开放的对应物进行可复制的研究.
Matrax Persona 1M [41] 贡献了最广泛的人口计划,跨越上游的1,290个绝对维度,我们从中采纳了十八个最有分析作用的维度. 其作者表示,本体只在一维边沿上校准,并不代表任何真实的种群,其相当一部分的人物文字来自属性,因此这种记录被贴上标签,从未作为真实的行为数据处理.
PersonaHub[42]是最大的连接体,大约为10亿合成人,但只使用文字:它没有结构化的人口领域,因此它作为文字材料参与检索,同时被设计排除在任何分布抽样之外。
新池子通过申报登记加入,记录来源、人名和人口领域及其归属和使用条件。 添加一个开放数据集只需要这种注册,并且一次性地将其记录正常化到共享词汇中.

blocks.en:
Studies with practical research problems often require persona attributes that no single pool fully covers.
For any requested set of attributes, the Population MCP identifies an anchor pool with the highest coverage, complement pools that contribute missing dimensions through statistical matching on shared attributes, and any attributes that remain uncovered.
Uncovered attributes are filled by conditioned synthesis : the missing values are generated conditional on each persona’s existing demographic profile, preserving the attribute correlations observed in the data.
When a study requires joint-distribution fidelity, iterative proportional fitting reweights the pool’s observed joint distribution to match the declared target marginals, preserving the attribute correlations present in the data.
If the target marginals call for population cells that no pool supports, the service either supplies clearly labeled synthetic respondents so that the delivered population still matches the requested margins, or, at the researcher’s choice, excludes those cells and reports the gap.
In both modes, coverage limitations are reported explicitly.
blocks.zh:
具有实际研究问题的研究往往需要没有单一池能完全覆盖的人的属性.
对于任何要求的一组属性,人口MCP确定一个覆盖度最高的锚定池,通过对共享属性的统计匹配来补充那些贡献缺失维度的集合,以及任何尚未发现的属性.
未覆盖属性通过条件合成填充 : 缺失值的生成取决于每个人a 的现有人口概况,保留数据中观察到的属性相关性。
当一项研究需要联合分配忠诚时,迭代比例配对重新加权该池观测到的联合分布,以匹配宣布的目标边际,保留数据中存在的属性相关性.
如果目标边际要求没有池子支持的人口细胞,那么服务要么提供有明确标签的合成应答者,以便交付的人口仍然符合所要求的边际,要么在研究人员的选择下,排除这些细胞并报告差距。
在这两种模式中,都明确报告了覆盖面限制。

blocks.en: The Population MCP exposes ten typed tools organized into four functional groups. Discovery lists the registered pools, describes their schemas, and queries value distributions. Routing performs cross-pool field matching with coverage analysis. Retrieval covers profile search and individual lookup. Simulation runs end-to-end population sampling with optional IPF reweighting and parallel LLM questionnaire execution.
blocks.zh: " 人口MCP " 将10种类型工具分为4个功能组。 发现者列出了注册的池,描述了它们的计划,以及查询值分布. 运行进行跨池场匹配覆盖分析. 检索覆盖配置搜索和个人查询. 模拟进行端到端的人口抽样,可选择地对森林小组重新加权,并同时执行LLM调查表。

blocks.en:
The standard flow from the user pool to a study’s P P runs in six steps, as shown in Figure 7 .
(1) Declare target marginal distributions, taken from census tables, survey microdata, or domain knowledge.
(2) Route to the best-matching pool or pools via cross-pool field matching.
(3) Sample from the anchor pool and complement missing dimensions from secondary pools via statistical matching on shared keys.
(4) Apply IPF to align the joint distribution to target marginals.
(5) Synthesize any remaining unresolved attributes conditioned on existing demographics, recording the source of every attribute for later attribution.
(6) Assemble each persona with demographic tags, a natural-language profile, and domain-specific initial state.
The agentic research pipeline is compatible with both the Population MCP and any user-uploaded population files.
A study can equally draw its population from a researcher-supplied data file or from a study-specific construction, and in every case the population is materialized once at initialization, deterministically under a declared seed, so that repeating a study reproduces exactly the same set of agents and the panel key of § 3.2 remains stable across versions.
blocks.zh:
如图7所示,标准从用户池到研究的PP分六步运行。
(1)从人口普查表,调查微观数据,或域知识中提取的申报目标边际分布.
(2)通过跨池场对接,通往最佳匹配池或池的路线.
(3) 通过共享密钥的统计匹配,从主机库中提取样本,并补充第二主机库中缺失的维度。
(4) 应用森林小组使联合分配与目标边际一致。
(5)以现有人口统计为条件,合成任何尚未解决的属性,记录每个属性的来源,以便日后归属.
(6) 将每个人a 与人口标记、自然语言简介和特定域的初始状态组合在一起。
代理研究程序与人口MCP和任何用户加载的人口文件都兼容。
一项研究同样可以从研究人员提供的数据文件或特定研究构造中抽取其人口,在每一种情况下,在初始化时,在宣布的种子下确定其人口,从而重复一项研究可以复制完全相同的一组物剂,第3.2节的面板键在各版本中保持稳定。

blocks.en: 4.3 Real-World Signal Sources and the Event MCP
blocks.zh: 4.3 真实世界信号源和活动MCP

blocks.en: On the environment side, the Event MCP serves 21+ structured signal sources with point-in-time guarantees.
blocks.zh: 在环境方面,事件MCP为21+结构化信号源服务,并有即时保证.

blocks.en:
The Event MCP aggregates 21 structured data sources organized into four categories ( Table 4 ).
Beyond U.S.-centric sources, the catalog includes the World Bank API (GDP, CPI, unemployment, and trade indicators for seven major economies), enabling cross-national studies and macro-economic simulations that require non-U.S. context.
The catalog is extensible: each source is wrapped as an independent connector behind a common interface, so new data sources can be added without changes to the rest of the platform.
blocks.zh:
事件MCP将21个结构化的数据来源汇总为四类(表4)。
除了以美国为中心的来源外,目录还包括世界银行的API(GDP,CPI,失业,以及七个主要经济体的贸易指标),能够进行跨国研究和需要非美国背景的宏观经济模拟.
该目录是可扩展的:每个源作为一个独立的连接器包裹在一个共同的界面后面,因此可以不改变其他平台而添加新的数据源.

blocks.en: Table 4: Signal sources available through the Event MCP, grouped by category. Sources marked with ⋆ \star are enabled by default.
blocks.zh: 表4:按类别分类的通过事件MCP提供的信号源。 默认启用了 QQ\ star 标记的源 。

blocks.en: Figure 8: One call to the Event MCP. A request specifies the study horizon and sources. The service lists the catalog, fetches each source as of the requested year and month so that nothing published later is visible, and stamps provenance. The build-environment skill then materializes the result as an external-events bundle and translates it into broadcasts and scheduled events bound to steps, so the run itself fetches nothing.
blocks.zh: 图 8: 1呼叫事件MCP. 一项请求具体说明研究的视野和来源。 服务列出目录,从要求的年份和月份获取每个来源,以便以后公布的任何内容都看不到,以及邮票的来源。 建筑-环境技巧然后通过一个外部活动捆绑实现结果,并将其翻译为广播和预定的活动,捆绑在台阶上,因此跑步本身一无所获.

blocks.en:
For any forecasting or nowcasting study (e.g., § 5.4.1 , § 5.4.2 , and § 5.4.3 ), credibility depends on the guarantee that the simulation at step t t sees only data that was publicly available at the corresponding real-world date.
The Event MCP enforces this through vintage-safe access: queries are parameterized by (year, month), and each collector returns only the data vintage that would have been available at that point.
This prevents look-ahead bias and makes all temporal evaluations methodologically sound, and it applies equally to an intervention added later in a study: a broadcast declared for a given month is grounded by the same as-of query, so the intervened branch is held to the same information discipline as the parent run.
blocks.zh:
对于任何预测或现成研究(例如,第5.4.1节、第5.4.2节和第5.4.3节),可信度取决于是否保证模拟仅看到在相应的真实世界日公开的数据。
Eventure MCP通过 vintage-security 访问执行此功能:查询按(年份,月份)参数化,每个采集器只返回当时可以使用的数据版本.
这可以防止外观偏差,使所有时间评价在方法上健全,它同样适用于一项研究稍后增加的干预:宣布的某一月份的广播以相同的查询为基础,因此干预的分支与母运行时一样受到相同的信息约束.

blocks.en:
The Event MCP answers three kinds of requests: listing the available sources and what they cover, retrieving data from multiple sources for a given year and month, and retrieving a single source in detail with optional sub-series selection.
Every response carries structured data together with its provenance, so that any environmental signal used in a study can be traced back to its origin.
blocks.zh:
事件MCP回答了三种请求:列出现有来源及其涵盖内容,从多个来源检索特定年份和月份的数据,用可选的子序列选择详细检索单个来源.
每个反应都携带结构化数据及其来源,这样研究中使用的任何环境信号都可以追溯到其来源.

blocks.en:
The standard flow from the signal sources to a study’s E E runs in six steps, as shown in Figure 8 .
(1) Declare the study horizon as a range of year-month pairs and select the sources the study needs.
(2) List the catalog to confirm the coverage and fields of each selected source.
(3) Fetch each source as of every month of the horizon, so that the payload of a month holds only what had been published by then.
(4) Stamp every payload with its provenance, that is, the source, the series, and the vintage it came from.
(5) Materialize the stamped payloads in the study workspace as an external-events bundle, so that the run reads from the workspace and never from the services, which is what makes a run self-contained and a replayed branch comparable with its parent.
(6) Translate the bundle into the two channels of the environment, broadcasts for the information layer and scheduled events for the physical layer, each bound to the step of its month (§ 3.2 ).
Steps 2 to 4 take place inside the service and steps 5 and 6 inside the build-environment skill, so resolution happens at build time and not at run time.
blocks.zh:
如图8所示,标准从信号源流到一个研究的E E 分六步运行。
(1)申报研究视野范围为一年月对,选择研究所需来源.
(2)列出目录,确认每个选定来源的覆盖范围和字段.
(3) 从地平线每个月获取每个来源,这样一个月的有效载荷就只能持有当时公布的东西.
(4) 用其原产地,即源头,系列,以及它来自的古董,标记每个载荷.
(5)将研究工作空间中印有有效载荷的材料化为外部活动捆绑,使运行从工作空间读取,从不从服务中读取,这就使得运行自成一体的分支和重播分支与母分支具有可比性.
(6) 将捆绑物转换成环境的两个渠道,为信息层广播,为物理层排定事件,每个过程都与月的台阶挂钩(第3.2节)。
第二步至第四步在服务内部进行,第五步至第六步在建设-环境技能内进行,因此解析发生在建设时间而不是运行时间.

blocks.en: 4.4 Governance, Auditability, and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 4.4 治理、可审计性和可复制性

blocks.en:
The Population MCP exposes only demographic tags and statistical profiles, never raw social-media content or personally identifiable information, and all access passes through the typed service interface.
All pools comply with the terms of service of their source platforms.
One open pool (MatrAIx) includes personas derived from public information about public figures. These records are used only in research settings, and ingestion removes fictional characters and minors.
blocks.zh:
Population MCP只披露人口标记和统计概况,从不披露原始的社会-媒体内容或个人可识别的信息,所有访问都通过输入的服务界面.
所有集合都符合其源平台的服务条款.
一个开放式的人才库(MatrAIx)包括来自公众人物信息的人物. 这些记录只用于研究环境,摄入会去掉虚构的人物和未成年人.

blocks.en:
Every registered pool and signal source carries a documented attribution and a usage tier.
Sources cleared for unrestricted use are available to production runs and published studies, whereas sources with restricted or undeclared terms are limited to research and demonstration use and require explicit per-study confirmation before any commercial run.
Generated study reports automatically include a data-basis section crediting every pool and signal source used, so licensing obligations propagate to the studies built on the platform.
blocks.zh:
每个注册的集合和信号源都包含有文件的归属和使用级.
允许不受限制使用的来源可用于生产经营和出版的研究,而限制或未申报条件的来源仅限于研究和示范使用,需要在商业经营前明确确认每期研究。
生成的研究报告自动包括一个数据基部分,对所使用的每个集合和信号源进行入计,因此许可证义务被推广到平台上建立的研究中.

blocks.en:
Every stage of the pipeline writes its artifact to disk, every intervention is logged in the events table, every run is versioned, and every study declares the data services, datasets, and tools it depends on.
Any conclusion in a report can therefore be traced through the trajectory store to the study definition, environment bundle, population bundle, and intervention schedule that produced it, and through the resource manifest to the pools and signal vintages behind them.
blocks.zh:
每一阶段的管道都将其文物写成磁盘,每一次干预都被记录在事件表中,每一次运行都被版本,每一次研究都宣布数据服务,数据集,以及它所依赖的工具.
因此,报告的任何结论都可以通过轨迹储存追踪到研究定义、环境捆绑、人口捆绑和产生这种定义的干预时间表,也可以通过显示在其后面的集合和信号图象的资源。

blocks.en:
Pool snapshots are versioned. Signal sources are archived by vintage (year-month).
A study’s resource manifest pins the pool and source versions it depends on, and the trajectory store records which external-events bundle was used for each run.
Combined with the deterministic-seed population construction and the archived environment artifacts, this ensures that any published result can be reproduced from the same data inputs.
blocks.zh:
Pool快照版本化. 信号源通过vintage(年份-月)存档.
一项研究的资源清单会标注它所依赖的集合和源版本,以及每次运行所使用的外部活动捆绑的轨迹存储。
这与确定性-种子人口建设和存档的环境文物相结合,可确保从同样的数据输入中复制任何公布的结果。

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation on Social Science Simulation
blocks.zh: 5 社会科学模拟评价.

blocks.en:
This section evaluates SocioVerse2 as an instrument for social science through seven case studies organized into three families, spanning from methodological benchmarking to real-world forecasting.
§ 5.1 introduces the shared workflow and evaluation dimensions. § 5.2 , § 5.3 , and § 5.4 present each family in turn, progressing from reproducing known dynamics to predicting outcomes not yet observed at simulation time.
Each case is realized in the framework of Section 3 and operated through the infrastructure of Section 4 . Consequently, interventions and branches inside the longitudinal simulation loop, and reference conditions and ablations as versions raised in the controllable research loop, are both realized in seven cases.
blocks.zh:
本节通过分为三个家庭的7个案例研究,从方法基准到现实世界的预测,对作为社会科学工具的社会Verse2进行评价。
§5.1引入了共享的工作流程和评价层面. §5.2、§5.3和§5.4依次呈现每个家族,从复制已知动态发展到预测模拟时尚未观察到的结果。
每个案件都在第3款的框架内实现,并通过第4款的基础设施运作。 因此,纵向模拟循环内的干预和分支以及可控研究循环中作为版本提出的参考条件和模拟,在7个案例中都得到了实现。

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation Methods
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价方法

blocks.en: Figure 9: Realization of a case study in the framework and the flow of its results into evaluation. Each case is realized through three uniform steps: research question, framework mapping, and experimental design. Its silicon samples then act over the horizon, and the results are read from four angles. The agentic pipeline carries every step. The controllable research loop spans the three realization steps, where an edit to P P , E E , f f , or Θ \Theta raises a new version, and the longitudinal simulation loop spans the run, where interventions fork branches.
blocks.zh: 图9:框架案例研究的实现情况及其成果纳入评价的情况。 每个案例都通过三个统一的步骤实现:研究问题,框架映射和实验设计. 其硅样品然后作用于地平线,结果从四个角度读取. 代理管道 承载每一个步骤。 可控研究循环跨越三个实现步骤,即一个编辑到PP,E E,f f,或 + \Theta 生成一个新版本,纵向模拟循环跨越运行,其中干预叉分支.

blocks.en: Each case study follows the same three phases ( Figure 9 ).
blocks.zh: 每个案例研究都遵循相同的三个阶段(图9)。

blocks.en:
The research question states what the simulated aggregate must match and what the trajectory is expected to add, with a directional hypothesis.
The framework mapping states the population, the environment, and the behavior function separately, so that a case is an instantiation of Equation 1 whose three terms can be inspected and replaced independently.
The experimental design specifies, in fixed order, the ground truth and evaluation window, the reference conditions against which the simulation is scored, the longitudinal protocol, and, where applicable, a mechanism probe by ablation or intervention. The longitudinal protocol covers the time unit, step length in real time, horizon, the state carried across steps, and the number of repetitions.
These steps correspond to the artifacts that the agentic pipeline produces, so a case is executable from its case description: the population and environment bundles realize the mapping, and the intervention schedule and run configuration realize the design.
The simulated individuals then act over the horizon as silicon samples , a fixed panel that observes the environment, decides through the behavior function, and changes the environment step by step, with interventions entering where the design declares them.
In terms of Equation 8 , a reference condition is a version that replaces f f or P P , an ablation is a version that removes one component, and an intervention branch is one that shares its parent’s history, so every comparison in this section is a comparison between versions or between branches of one study, and the reported result of each case is the version its researchers accepted.
blocks.zh:
研究提出的问题是,模拟聚合物必须匹配什么,轨道预期会增加什么,并附有一个方向假设。
框架映射对人口,环境和行为功能分别进行了描述,这样一例就是即时化的方程式1,其三个术语可以独立检查和替换.
实验设计按固定顺序规定了地面真象和评估窗口,模拟所根据的参考条件,纵向协议,以及在适用的情况下通过衰减或干预进行机制探测. 纵向协议涵盖时间单位,步长实时,地平线,状态跨步携带,重复次数.
这些步骤与代理管道产生的文物相对应,因此一个案例从其案例描述中可以执行:人口和环境捆绑实现绘图,干预时间表和运行配置实现设计.
模拟个体在地平线上作为硅样品行动, 一个观察环境的固定面板, 通过行为功能来决定, 并一步一步地改变环境,

blocks.en:
The results of every case are read from four angles in a fixed order, each against the ground truth the design names. Micro alignment asks whether individual silicon samples respond as their real counterparts did, where individual records exist. Level fidelity asks whether endpoints or per-period aggregates agree with the ground truth. Trajectory fidelity asks whether the course over time agrees with the observed course, measured by quantities that change when only the order of steps changes. Mechanism asks what ablations, intervention branches, and per-agent records reveal about why the aggregate moves, by comparing branches of the same simulation. This dimension also identifies where the simulation’s agreement with ground truth breaks down.
The ground truth differs by family: rule-based dynamics and observed opinion trajectories in the mechanism family, census patterns and historical procurement records in the policy family, and official statistics and registration data in the forecasting family.

The two cases in this family examine the mechanics of LLM social simulation itself, establishing that the instrument reproduces known dynamics before it is applied to policy and forecasting questions, and they emphasize the reference conditions of the template: rule-based dynamics against LLM-driven decisions in the benchmark case (§ 5.2.1 ), and pure rule-based populations against hybrid populations that couple LLM-driven core users with rule-based ordinary users in a Twitter-like environment (§ 5.2.2 ).

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Case Study 1: Reproducing Canonical ABMs with LLM Agents
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 案例研究 1: 以LLM代理复制Canonical反弹道导弹

blocks.en:
Classical agent-based models are the canonical demonstrations that collective patterns emerge from simple local rules: Schelling’s residential model produces segregation from mild individual preferences [ 1 ] , and the Sugarscape economy grows wealth inequality from foraging agents on a resource landscape [ 2 ] .
Their dynamics are known, reproducible, and rule-based, which makes them the natural reference for asking whether LLM-driven decision functions preserve the mechanisms that social science has already validated.
The case asks two questions: whether, once the hand-coded rules are replaced by LLM-driven decisions over the same observations and actions, the same group-level outcomes arise, and whether the LLM-driven trajectory follows the same course toward those outcomes, and how the course changes when the decision context is enriched beyond the scalar statistics of the classical rule.
The hypothesis is directional: LLM-driven runs are expected to reach consistency scores close to the run-to-run agreement of the rule-based model itself, with the widest gaps on tasks whose reference is deterministic or whose actions are continuous, and enriched context is expected to change the tempo of convergence without changing its endpoint.
blocks.zh:
古典代理模型是从简单的本地规则中产生的集体模式的犬类示范: Schelling的住宅模式造成与温和的个人偏好隔离[1],糖景经济从资源景观上的觅食物剂加剧了财富不平等[2].
它们的动力学是已知的,可复制的,基于规则的,这使得它们成为询问LLM驱动的决策功能是否保留社会科学已经验证的机制的自然参考.
该案提出了两个问题:一旦手编码规则被LLM驱动的关于相同观察和行动的决定所取代,是否会产生相同的组级结果;LLM驱动的轨迹是否沿着相同方向走向这些结果;当决定背景的丰富程度超出古典规则的尺度统计时,该路线是如何变化的。
假设是方向性的:LLM驱动的运行预期会达到接近基于规则的模型本身的运行到运行的协议的一致性分数,在参考是决定性的或者其行动是连续的的任务上存在最宽广的缺口,而丰富的上下文预计会改变趋同节奏而不改变其终点.

blocks.en:
Level fidelity: LLM-driven decisions approach the ceiling set by stochastic variability alone. Figure 10 reports the consistency scores across the suite.
The control group achieves a mean consistency of 0.911, the empirical upper bound for any behavior function evaluated under this protocol.
Against this ceiling, GPT-4o reaches 0.898, DeepSeek-V3 0.900, and Qwen3-235B 0.885 averaged over the ten tasks, so the gap between the best LLM condition and the rule-based model’s own run-to-run agreement is about one hundredth.
The three LLM conditions lie within 0.015 of one another on the suite average, and their per-task profiles rise and fall together across the four families. GPT-4o has the smallest cross-task dispersion, and Qwen3-235B the largest, with its lowest scores on Opinion Dynamics and Collective Motion.
Task structure therefore accounts for more of the variation than model choice.
blocks.zh:
水平忠诚度:由LLM驱动的决定接近仅由结构变化设定的上限。 图10报告整个套间的一致性分数。
控制组实现0.911的平均一致性,即本协议所评价的任何行为功能的实证上限.
在这一上限下,GPT-4o达到0.898、DeepSeek-V3 0.900和Qune3-235B 0.885平均完成十项任务,因此最好的LLM条件和基于规则的模型自己的跑对跑协议之间的差距大约是一百分之一.
三个LLM条件在套房平均相差0.015以内,他们每个任务的情况在四个家庭之间一起上升和下降。 GPT-4o拥有最小的跨任务分散,而Qwen3-235B则是最大的,在"观点动态"和"集体运动"上得分最低.
因此,任务结构的变动比模型选择多。

blocks.en:
Trajectory fidelity: the agreement is mechanistic as well as numerical. Social Segregation is the most stable task in the suite, with the control group and all three LLM conditions within a few hundredths of one another near the top of the scale, and Rumor Spreading keeps two of the three LLM conditions close to its control group.
The qualitative comparison in Figure 18 ( Appendix A ) shows the same course under both implementations: Hegselmann–Krause opinions at confidence bound ε = 0.15 \varepsilon=0.15 converge to three clusters, and the SIR rumor on a Watts–Strogatz contact network reproduces the spreader peak followed by saturation of the informed population.
The mechanism probe locates where the LLM adds to the classical dynamics.
With the rule’s scalar context, the LLM-driven Schelling population converges to full satisfaction by step 12, on the same course as the rule. With the enriched context it reaches the same fully segregated endpoint at step 18, because agents that weigh moving costs and patience relocate less readily at the first sign of dissatisfaction [ 43 ] .
Enriching the context thus changes the tempo of the trajectory and leaves its terminal pattern intact, which is the kind of difference that only a step-by-step record can register.
blocks.zh:
轨迹忠诚:协议既具有机械性,也具有数字性。 社会隔离是套房中最稳定的任务,控制组和所有三个LLM条件都在相邻的几百分之一范围内接近天平顶层,而传言传播使得三个LLM条件中的两个都接近其控制组.
图18(附录A)中的质量比较显示了两个执行下的相同方向:Hegselmann–Krause 置信于约束== 0.15\varepsilon= 0.15 集中到三组,一个Watts–Storgaz接触网上的SIR谣言转载了传播者高峰,然后是知情人群饱和.
机理探测器定位LLM对古典动力学的补充位置.
随着规则的伸缩,LLM驱动的Schelling人口通过第12步,在规则的同一方向上聚集到完全满意. 随着环境的丰富,它在第18步达到完全隔离的终点,因为那些权衡移动成本和耐心的代理人在最初的不满迹象中不易迁移[43].
丰富上下文从而改变轨迹的节奏,使其终极图案完好无损,这种差异只有一步步的记录才能记录下来.

blocks.en:
Boundary: the largest gaps arise where the reference is deterministic, the metric is unstable, or the action is continuous. Prisoner’s Dilemma shows the widest separation between conditions: its round-robin tournament of fixed strategies makes the control group nearly self-identical, whereas all three LLM conditions fall well below it, since deterministic strategies leave no stochastic slack and any deviation in a single per-strategy score is counted in full.
Opinion Dynamics records the lowest scores of the suite for every condition, including the control group, with the widest error bars, because its metric vector counts final opinion clusters at three confidence bounds, a quantity that shifts discretely under small perturbations. All three LLM conditions match or exceed the control group on this task, and GPT-4o and DeepSeek-V3 also score above the control group on Minority Games, where LLM runs sit closer to the ten-run rule mean than individual stochastic rule runs do.
Collective Motion, whose actions are heading vectors, yields the lowest control-group score among flow models and the widest spread across LLM conditions, whereas Crowd Evacuation, the other continuous-action task, stays close to its control group. The difficulty is specific to flocking, whose metric vector (polarization, nearest-neighbor distance, spread) registers small heading deviations directly.
Together with Prisoner’s Dilemma, these tasks delineate the regime in which exact numerical or geometric computation is required, where the typed-action contract that makes rule and LLM outputs comparable also exposes every deviation in full.
blocks.zh:
边界:当参考物具有决定性、度量不稳定或动作连续时,会出现最大的空白。 囚犯的“困境”显示了各种条件之间最广泛的区别:其轮旋式固定战略锦标赛使得控制组几乎自成一体,而所有三种LLM条件都远远低于它,因为确定性战略没有留下任何扭曲的松懈之处,而且每个战略中的任何偏差都算在内。
Politics Dynamics记录每个条件的套件中最低的分数,包括控制组,最宽的误差栏,因为它的度量矢量在三个置信限上计算最终的舆论集群,这个数量在小扰动下分散移动. 所有三种LLM条件都匹配或超过此任务的控制组,GPT-4o和DeepSeek-V3也得分高于少数民族运动会的控制组,LLM运行比个人的stochtic规则运行更接近十运行规则的平均值.
集体运动的行动是向量,它在流动模型中产生的控制组得分最低,在LLM条件下的分布最广泛,而人群疏散是另一个持续行动的任务,它仍然与其控制组相近。 困难是针对羊群的,其测量矢量(极化、近邻距离、分布)直接记录小方向偏差。
这些任务与《囚犯的困境》一起,界定了需要精确数字或几何计算的制度,使规则和LLM产出具有可比性的打字作业合同也暴露了所有偏差。

LLM- f f serves as a drop-in replacement for rule- f f across the ten models, reproducing the emergent outcomes to within the rule-based model’s own run-to-run agreement and following the same course toward them, with enriched context altering the tempo of the dynamics and leaving their endpoint intact.
The typed-action contract that makes this comparison possible also marks its boundary, since tasks demanding exact numerical or continuous control expose every deviation, which is where the hybrid- f f pattern of § 5.2.2 applies.

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Case Study 2: Hybrid Opinion Dynamics on Social Media
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 案例研究2:社会媒体的混合意见动态

blocks.en:
Social media has become a central arena of social movements, and simulating how the public responds after a triggering event, from the leak of a court opinion to a viral hashtag, has become a matter of both scientific and practical concern [ 11 ] .
Engagement on these platforms is highly skewed: a small set of active and influential opinion leaders shapes the discourse, while the bulk of participants respond with far simpler behavior.
Driving every user with an LLM is unaffordable at the population scales such events involve, and classical opinion-dynamics models cannot express the reasoning and discourse strategies of the influential minority.
This case asks whether a hybrid population, in which a few hundred LLM-driven core users are coupled with a large rule-based population of ordinary users, reproduces the observed collective opinion trajectory after a triggering event, and whether it does so at a cost that stays flat as the ordinary population grows.
The hypothesis is directional: for every rule governing the ordinary users, coupling in the LLM-driven core is expected to raise the correlation with the observed trajectory, with the largest correction where the rule alone misses the direction of change, and the run time is expected to depend on the number of core users only.

参与这些平台是高度扭曲的:一小撮活跃和有影响力的舆论领袖塑造了这些言论,而大多数参与者的反应则更加简单。
在人口规模上,驾驶每个使用LLM的用户都负担不起这类活动,而古典的舆论动态模型无法表达有影响力的少数群体的推理和言论策略。
此案询问,混合人口,即几百个LLM驱动的核心用户与大量普通用户的基于规则的人口组合在一起,是否在触发事件后复制了观察到的集体意见轨迹,而这样做的代价是否随着普通人口的增长而保持不变.
该假说是方向性的:对于每个规范普通用户的规则,LLM驱动核心中的耦合预期会提高与所观测到的轨迹的关联性,其中最大的修正就是仅该规则就错过了变化的方向,运行时间预计只取决于核心用户的数量.

blocks.en: The case instantiates the framework’s hybrid- f f pattern (§ 3.2 ) on a two-tier population situated in a Twitter-like environment, with the per-step group attitude distribution as the longitudinal trajectory. • Population P P . Each event is simulated with 1,000 users drawn from the real participants of that event: 300 core users, selected by influence and activity, are LLM-driven simulated individuals constructed from their real profiles, historical tweets (personal memory), and follower lists. The other 700 are rule-based simulated individuals whose initial attitudes are annotated from their real tweets. • Environment E E . A Twitter-like information environment provides each user with a timeline of the most recent visible tweets, follower-graph visibility, and a notification inbox, together with turn-indexed news injections that introduce real-world developments at designated steps. Each event window is simulated as 14 steps of 12 hours, so that a seven-day period is covered (in the Roe scenario, the overturn is injected at step 0 and a report of protest arrests at step 11). • Behavior function f f . Core users run LLM- f f : persona, timeline, and memory are composed into a prompt that yields a typed action (post, retweet, reply, like, or no action) with its content. Ordinary users run rule- f f under one of five classical opinion-dynamics models (bounded confidence [ 44 ] , Hegselmann–Krause, Lorenz, relative agreement, or social judgement), which update a scalar attitude. The two tiers are coupled through mirror agents: every core user has a counterpart inside the rule-based model whose attitude is overwritten at each step with the stance and intensity scored from that core user’s actual message, so that the reasoning of opinion leaders propagates into the ordinary population. Influence in the reverse direction is not modeled, following the original design.

blocks.en: • Ground truth and window. The observed collective attitude trajectory of each movement, annotated from the real tweets of the 1,000 simulated users at every step. Three U.S. movements, MeToo (sexual harassment), Roe v. Wade (abortion rights), and Black Lives Matter (racial justice), each observed in two event windows of about one week [ 11 ] . The first window of each movement serves calibration and the second window validation. All results below are on the validation window. • Reference conditions. Every hybrid configuration is paired with the pure rule-based model that shares its parameters, for each of the five opinion-dynamics rules, giving fifteen hybrid-versus-pure pairings across the three movements. Parameters are swept in pure rule-based form on the calibration window and transferred to the hybrid configuration, so the comparison holds the rule and its parameters fixed and varies only the presence of the LLM-driven core. • Longitudinal protocol. 1,000 users per movement (300 core, 700 ordinary), 14 steps of 12 hours. Core users driven by LLM agents. Macro results averaged over three runs per scenario. Two levels of evaluation: micro alignment tests whether individual core users reproduce the stance, content, and action type of their real counterparts in single-turn responses to the context they actually saw. macro dynamics compares the simulated and observed group attitude trajectories over the 14 steps by Pearson correlation (Corr) and the deviation of mean attitude ( Δ \Delta Bias). • Mechanism probe. The rule governing the ordinary users is treated as an experimental variable across the five models, and three platform interventions are applied on the MeToo scenario: feeding users opposing opinions, feeding neutral opinions, and opening public hashtag spaces for discussion [ 11 ] . The study is re-implemented natively on the SocioVerse2 engine as a from-scratch study, with the two tiers as implementations of one decision model and the mirror coupling as an environment update. In that re-implementation, the five ordinary-user rules are versions that vary f f , and the three platform interventions are declared broadcasts, so each intervened run is a branch of the uninterrupted one.

blocks.en:
Micro alignment: LLM-driven core users reproduce the positions of their real counterparts. At the individual level ( Table 6 ), the core users match the recorded responses of the people they simulate.
Stance accuracy lies between 0.90 and 0.97 across the three movements and content similarity exceeds 0.80, while the type of action a user takes (posting or retweeting) is predicted with accuracy between 0.67 and 0.78. Stance F1 is considerably lower than stance accuracy in all three movements.
blocks.zh:
微调:LLM驱动的核心用户复制其真实对应方的位置. 在个人层面(表6),核心用户与其模拟人员记录的答复相匹配。
硬度精确度在0.90至0.97之间,这三种运动和内容相似度超过0.80,而用户所采取行动(张贴或再贴)的类型则准确预测在0.67至0.78之间。 Stance F1在所有三个运动中都大大低于姿态精确度.

blocks.en: Table 6: Micro-level alignment of LLM core users against real user responses: stance (support, neutral, oppose), content type (five classes) and text similarity, and behavior type (post or retweet).
blocks.zh: 表6:LLM核心用户相对于真实用户响应的微级对齐:姿态(支持,中性,反对),内容类型(五类)和文本相似性,以及行为类型(后或重播).

blocks.en:
Trajectory fidelity: coupling core users to the rule-based population improves the shape of the collective trajectory in every configuration. Across the fifteen model–scenario pairings reported in the original study, the hybrid variant attains higher correlation than its pure-ABM counterpart in all fifteen ( Table 7 ). The best hybrid configurations reach correlations of 0.724 (MeToo), 0.758 ( Roe ), and 0.605 (BLM), against 0.483, 0.733, and 0.448 for the best pure-ABM model of each scenario.
The correction is most visible where the rule-based model alone misses the direction of change, as the two bounded-confidence rules do in the Roe scenario.
Absolute-level bias does not improve uniformly. The Lorenz-based hybrid attains the lowest Δ \Delta Bias in all three scenarios, whereas the relative-agreement hybrid trades a larger bias for the best correlation in two of them.
blocks.zh:
轨迹忠贞:将核心用户与基于规则的人口组合在一起,可以改善每个配置中集体轨迹的形状. 在最初研究报告中报告的15种模型 -- -- 假设配对中,混合变体在所有15种模型中的相关性都高于其纯反弹道导弹对应物(表7)。 最佳混合构型达到0.724(MeToo),0.758(Roe)和0.605(BLM)的关联度,而每种情况的最佳纯反导模型分别为0.483,0.733和0.448。
仅基于规则的模型就忽略了变化的方向,这最能引起人们的注意,正如在Roe情景中两种有限度的自信规则所做的那样。
绝对层面的偏见并没有统一改善。 基于洛伦兹的杂交种在所有三种情景中都取得了最低的QQ \Delta Bias,而相对协议的杂交种交易则在其中两种情景中对最佳关联性有较大的偏差.

blocks.en: Table 7: Macro-level trajectory evaluation on the validation window of each movement (mean of 3 runs). Corr: Pearson correlation with the observed attitude trajectory. Δ \Delta Bias: absolute deviation of the mean attitude. Best pure-ABM is the rule-based model with the highest correlation per scenario. The hybrid rows are the configurations with the best correlation or the lowest bias.
blocks.zh: 表7:对每次运动的验证窗口进行宏观级轨迹评价(平均值为3运行). Corr:皮尔逊与观测到的姿态轨迹的关联. \Delta Bias: 绝对偏差的刻薄态度. 最佳纯反弹道导弹是基于规则的模型,每个情景具有最高的相关性. 混合行是具有最佳相关性或最低偏差的配置.

blocks.en: The hybrid trajectories follow the direction and timing of the major attitude shifts in all three movements. In Figure 11 , the simulated series rises or falls with the observed one after the initial trigger, settles over the following steps, and moves again when a follow-up development is injected, which is the behavior the correlation summarizes.
blocks.zh: 混合轨迹沿袭三大运动中主要态度转变的方向和时间. 在图11中,模拟序列在初始触发后随被观测到的序列一起上升或下降,在以下步骤上安顿下来,并在一个后续开发注入时再次移动,这就是关联总结的行为.

blocks.en:
Mechanism: the rule governing ordinary users is an experimental variable, and platform interventions register in the panel. No single rule fits every movement.
The Lorenz model gives the best bias and the best Roe correlation, relative agreement gives the best correlation for MeToo and BLM, and the two bounded-confidence variants remain the weakest hybrids in the Roe and BLM scenarios. The five interchangeable models therefore serve as an ablation of the ordinary-user mechanism, and the calibrate-in-rule, validate-in-hybrid protocol keeps this ablation affordable.
The three interventions on the MeToo scenario show that the same simulation supports platform-design questions: all three reduce the homogeneity between produced and consumed content, and opening public discussion spaces does so at the lowest toxicity [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh:
机制:规范普通用户的规则是一个实验变量,平台干预在面板中注册. 没有一条规则适合每一个运动。
Lorenz模型给出了最佳偏差和最佳Roe相关,相对一致给出了MeToo和BLM的最佳相关性,两个有界自信变体仍然是Roe和BLM情景中最弱的杂交体. 因此,这五个可互换的模型是普通用户机制的衰减,校准规则中验证-hybrid协议保持这种衰减的承受能力.
关于MeToo情景的三项发言表明,同样的模拟支持平台设计问题:所有三项都降低了生产内容和消费内容之间的同质性,打开公共讨论空间时的毒性最低[11].

blocks.en: Cost: fidelity is retained while the ordinary population grows, and the cost is pinned to the number of core users. In the scalability analysis of the original study, which fixes 300 core users and varies the number of ordinary users on the MeToo scenario, the trajectory correlation declines only slightly as the ordinary share increases, and runtime is dominated by LLM API latency, so that adding ordinary users imposes almost no additional cost until the population reaches the millions [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 成本:在普通人口增加的同时保持忠诚,成本由核心用户数量决定. 在原始研究的可扩展性分析中,该研究修补了300个核心用户,并改变了MeToo情景中的普通用户数量,轨迹相关性仅随着普通份额的增加而略有下降,运行时间以LLM API latency为主,因此在人口达到百万[11]之前,添加普通用户几乎不会带来额外费用.

blocks.en:
The hybrid- f f pattern reproduces observed opinion trajectories at a cost that grows with the number of LLM-driven opinion leaders and not with the population, because the mirror coupling carries the leaders’ reasoning into a rule-based majority.
The case also shows why trajectories are the object of study: a snapshot records the attitude distribution in a cross-section, whereas the step-by-step record shows how that distribution moved after each injected development and each platform intervention.
blocks.zh:

案例还显示了轨道为何成为研究对象:一个快照记录了一个横截面的姿态分布,而分步记录则显示该分布在每次注入开发后和每个平台干预后是如何移动的.

blocks.en: 5.3 Case Family II: Policy Simulation
blocks.zh: 5.3 个案家庭 二:政策模拟

blocks.en:
Policy simulation asks what follows from an intervention before it is administered.
The two cases in this family exercise the longitudinal machinery built for this question, populations grounded in real records and behavior that evolves with a changing environment, and they emphasize the mechanism probe of the template: ablations that isolate what drives the aggregate, and reference conditions that hold the environment fixed while the decision model changes.
The segregation case extends the Schelling model, validated as a synthetic benchmark in § 5.2.1 , to real Chicago census data (781 tracts and calibrated household archetypes), shifting the ground truth from rules to the observed pattern of segregation (§ 5.3.1 ).
The procurement case models China’s national drug procurement as a multi-agent Markov game among government, enterprises, and healthcare institutions, with historical procurement outcomes across multiple bidding rounds as the ground truth (§ 5.3.2 ).
Both cases pose policy questions in the form of the longitudinal simulation loop: a policy is a declared intervention on E E , and its effect is read as a contrast between branches that share a history, while the reference rules and ablations are versions that vary f f or remove one component.
